name: Jupiter
blessing_text: Jupiter is pleased. In Rome, people speak well of the city.
wrath_text: Lightning out of a clear sky: Jupiter has struck a building.

name: Juno
blessing_text: Juno blesses the marriage beds. A season of births.
wrath_text: Juno has turned away from the city's homes. Few children are born this season.

name: Mars
blessing_text: Mars marches with the cohorts. Morale and training rise.
wrath_text: Mars is angry. Soldiers slip away from their posts at night.

name: Venus
blessing_text: Venus smiles, and the whole city is in a good mood.
wrath_text: Venus withdraws her favor. Quarrels in the streets, sour faces in the market.

name: Ceres
blessing_text: Ceres is generous. The harvest comes in heavy.
wrath_text: Blight. Ceres has been neglected, and the fields wither.

name: Neptune
blessing_text: Neptune calms the sea. Ships come in safely and the nets are full.
wrath_text: Neptune strikes the ground with his trident. The earth shakes!

name: Mercury
blessing_text: Mercury sends merchants our way, and prices turn in our favor.
wrath_text: Mercury turns his back. The merchants take their business elsewhere.

name: Minerva
blessing_text: Minerva walks through the workshops, and the work goes well.
wrath_text: Minerva is angry. Tools break and men are hurt in the workshops.

name: Vulcan
blessing_text: Vulcan keeps his fire in the forges. The city has few fires.
wrath_text: Vulcan's fire escapes the forge. A great fire!

name: Vesta
blessing_text: Vesta's flame burns steady, and every household is content.
wrath_text: Vesta's hearth fire leaps to the roofs!

name: Isis
blessing_text: Isis the healer walks among the sick, and they recover.
wrath_text: Isis is offended. Sickness comes up from the river.

name: Serapis
blessing_text: Serapis fills the granaries. A season of plenty.
wrath_text: Serapis withholds his gift, and the harvest fails.

name: Divus Augustus
blessing_text: Incense burns for the divine Emperor, and the palace notices.
wrath_text: The Emperor's temple stands cold. The palace notices that too.
